clip_gradients: clip gradient norms of a PyTorch model using the optimizer or nn.utils during training
get_optimizer_parameters: extract and group optimizer parameters from a PyTorch model supporting custom parameter methods
extract_loss: extract and aggregate loss values from an MMF model report dictionary with batch averaging
retry_n: retry a callable function n times with exponential backoff sleep intervals between attempts
scalarize_dict_values: convert tensor values in a dictionary to scalar tensors by computing their mean
